# Local Assets

- `Sortable.min.js`: SortableJS 1.15.6, MIT license. Source: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable/tree/1.15.6
- `../icons.svg`: selected icons from Lucide 1.8.0, ISC license (and the included upstream Feather notice). Source: https://lucide.dev

These assets are served locally; the site does not need a third-party CDN for icons or sorting.
